title: EvaluatorOutput
description: Final evaluator output for the Background Knowledge Demands evaluator.

identified_topics.description: The core subjects/concepts found in the text.

curriculum_check.description: Whether the topics are standard K-8 knowledge or specialized high-school-level knowledge.

assumptions_and_scaffolding.description: What the author assumes the reader already knows versus what is explained in the text.

friction_analysis.description: Whether difficulty comes from vocabulary/sentence structure or from actual background knowledge demands.

complexity_score.description: The background knowledge complexity level of the text.

reasoning.description: A detailed synthesis of why the text fits the chosen complexity level.
